items: ‌‌【Official Licensed FIFA Product】Authentic FIFA World Cup 2026 mascot figurines, officially licensed and display-ready for soccer fans and collectors

【Complete 3-Figure Set】Includes Clutch The USA, Zayu the Mexico and Maple the Canada in one collectible set, so you get the full trio in a single purchase, Made from durable vinyl, this collectible is built to last and withstand daily wear
【Clear Display Cases Included】Each figure comes in its own clear case for a clean, premium “collector shelf” look, perfect gifts for friends and families
【Made for Display】Display items designed specifically for collectors, not intended as a toy, suitable for ages 15+, great for fan collections, office decor and memorabilia setups
【Gift Idea for FIFA World Cup Fens】This figure is compact in size but delivers an exceptional display effect, making it a perfect gift for game days, birthdays, team celebrations, and fan collections
